name: UptimeRobot Sponsored Monitoring
description: UptimeRobot sponsors a paid Solo or Team plan for non-profit organizations and the open source projects they run, covering uptime monitoring, status pages and alerting.

perks.title: Sponsored paid plan
perks.description: A Solo or Team plan with all paid features, free for one year.

perks.title: 1-minute checks
perks.description: Website, keyword, ping, port, cron job and API monitoring at 1-minute intervals.

perks.title: Status pages
perks.description: Public status pages to share uptime and incident updates with your users.

perks.title: Chat support
perks.description: Help from the UptimeRobot team with setup and troubleshooting.

eligibility: Non-profit organizations and charities, and the open source projects they run.
applicationProcess: Apply through the form on the UptimeRobot sponsorship page with details about your organization and project.
